digest.component_or_area: completion-verifier close gate / verdict reconciliation & disposition
propositions: A runaway/exhaustion-truncated completion-verifier run is incorrectly disposed as a blocking FAIL (exit 1) instead of a non-blocking, re-runnable INDETERMINATE fault (exit 11) when evidence is insufficient but not definitively refuted.

The _restamp_marker function in completion_verdict_assembly pops the insufficiency marker for truncated criteria (entry is None) instead of stamping them as evidence_sufficient=False, making them indistinguishable from genuine refutations.

The close_precheck gate and verify-completion verb return hard-block exit 1 for insufficiency-only FAILs because they only recognize verdict_obtainable=False as a fault, not the evidence_sufficient=False marker that reconcile_verdict already derives.

A shared pure helper completion_fail_returncode(result) must route both verdict_obtainable=False and evidence_sufficient=False faults to retryable exit 11, ensuring disposition consistency across all callsites without overloading verdict_obtainable's schema.
Genuine refutations (met=false with conclusive bank entry, no insufficiency marker) must remain hard-block exit 1 to avoid masking substantive failures.
